clauses.scope_note: Cohere Client License Agreement, acceptance paragraph; Cohere Products.
clauses.condition_explanation: client_accepts_and_complies_with_agreement means Client accepts and agrees to be bound by the Agreement, as amended under Section 13(i), and complies with it. If Client does not accept, further use must cease immediately.

obligation_items.content: Immediately cease any further use of the Cohere Products if Client does not accept and agree to be bound by the Agreement.
obligation_items.trigger: Client does not accept and agree to be bound by the Agreement

clauses.scope_note: Cohere Client License Agreement, acceptance paragraph; use on behalf of another Person.
clauses.condition_explanation: The representation is triggered only when Client uses Cohere Products on another Person’s behalf.

obligation_items.content: Represent to Cohere that Client has authority to bind the other Person to the Agreement.
obligation_items.object: Agreement as applied to the represented Person
obligation_items.trigger: Client uses Cohere Products on behalf of another Person

clauses.scope_note: Section 1(b); Cohere Products and Cohere-provided Documentation; license is revocable, non-exclusive, non-sublicensable, non-transferable, and lasts during the Term. Product scope and entitlements depend on Partner Terms, including applicable Order Form and Scope of Work.
clauses.condition_explanation: The permission covers use of Cohere Products solely for Client’s internal business purposes by its employees and contractors in accordance with Partner Terms, and access and use of Cohere-provided Documentation to facilitate that use. The Agreement supplies no independent permission for other purposes.

clauses.actor_role: Client, Users, and third parties permitted access by Client
clauses.scope_note: Section 2 introductory restriction; Cohere Products. Operates together with the specific restrictions in Section 2 and the license grant in Section 1(b).
clauses.condition_explanation: Access or use is allowed only to the extent expressly permitted by both the CLA and Partner Terms; Client must not permit a User or third party to access or use outside that scope.

obligation_items.content: Do not access or use Cohere Products, or permit a User or third party to do so, except as expressly permitted by the CLA and Partner Terms.
obligation_items.trigger: Any access to or use of Cohere Products by Client, a User, or a third party

clauses.actor_role: Client, Users, and third parties permitted access by Client
clauses.scope_note: Section 2(a); access to or use of Cohere Products. Includes use involving Client Data and violations of applicable law or Documentation, including the Usage Policy.
clauses.condition_explanation: use_manner_or_purpose_meets_any_listed_ground is true if the manner or purpose violates or is contrary to applicable law or Documentation (including the Usage Policy); infringes, violates, or misappropriates Cohere’s or a third party’s intellectual property, publicity, personality, or privacy rights, including by processing Client Data without necessary rights, consents, or licenses; or adversely affects Cohere’s or its trademarks’ reputation or goodwill, or relationships between Cohere and its Clients and licensors. These grounds are alternatives.

obligation_items.content: Do not access or use Cohere Products in a manner or for a purpose that meets any of the listed prohibited grounds.
obligation_items.object: Cohere Products and, where relevant, Client Data processed in that use
obligation_items.trigger: Any access to or use by Client, a User, or a third party permitted by Client

clauses.actor_role: Client, Users, and third parties permitted access by Client
clauses.scope_note: Section 2(b); access to or use of Cohere Products and use of Client Output. The prohibition is purpose- or beneficiary-based.
clauses.condition_explanation: The grounds are alternatives: purpose of building or training a similar or competitive product or service (including a competitive AI model or training data for large language models); purpose of developing an application replicating the look and feel of Cohere Products; or use for the benefit of a direct Cohere competitor as reasonably determined by Cohere, including an entity offering large language models for license or sale. Client Output is expressly covered when it is used for these purposes.

obligation_items.content: Do not access or use Cohere Products, or use Client Output, for any of the prohibited competitive, replication, or competitor-benefit purposes.
obligation_items.object: Cohere Products or Client Output, as applicable
obligation_items.trigger: The access, use, or output use has any purpose or beneficiary listed in Section 2(b)

clauses.scope_note: Section 2(c); Cohere Products. Applies to making the Products available to any third party, including by distribution, sublicense, or resale.
clauses.condition_explanation: The prohibition covers distribution, sublicensing, resale, permitting access, or otherwise making Cohere Products available to a third party.

obligation_items.content: Do not distribute, sublicense, resell, permit access to, or otherwise make Cohere Products available to a third party.
obligation_items.trigger: Any proposed third-party distribution, access, or availability

clauses.scope_note: Section 2(d); Cohere Products, including their source code. The paragraph states no approval exception for decompiling, reverse engineering, reverse assembling, or disassembling; prior written approval is expressly relevant to Modify.
clauses.condition_explanation: Modification is barred without Cohere’s prior written approval. The listed reverse-engineering activities and otherwise accessing or modifying source code are also prohibited; the text does not state that approval lifts those separate prohibitions.

obligation_items.content: Do not modify Cohere Products without Cohere’s prior written approval; do not decompile, reverse engineer, reverse assemble, or disassemble them, or otherwise access or modify their source code.
obligation_items.object: Cohere Products and their source code
obligation_items.trigger: Any proposed modification, reverse-engineering activity, or source-code access

clauses.scope_note: Section 2(e); Cohere Products. Notice retention is a condition on use, not a separate distribution-only condition.
clauses.condition_explanation: Client must not remove or obscure proprietary notices or labels appearing on Cohere Products.

obligation_items.content: Do not remove or obscure proprietary notices or labels on Cohere Products.
obligation_items.object: Proprietary notices and labels on Cohere Products
obligation_items.trigger: Client’s access to or use of Cohere Products

clauses.actor_role: Client, Users, and third parties permitted access by Client
clauses.scope_note: Section 2(f); Cohere Products. Restricted Locations include Belarus, China (including Hong Kong and Macau), Cuba, Iran, North Korea, Russia, and Syria, and other locations Cohere may advise Client are restricted from time to time.
clauses.condition_explanation: The location restriction applies to access or use from any listed location or another location Cohere advises Client is a Restricted Location, directly or indirectly, from time to time.

obligation_items.content: Do not access or use Cohere Products from a Restricted Location.
obligation_items.trigger: Access or use from a location defined or later advised as a Restricted Location

clauses.scope_note: Section 3(a); Client Environment, meaning an on-premise or private cloud environment owned or controlled by Client.
clauses.condition_explanation: Client acknowledges it is solely responsible for its Client Environment and that environment’s security. The text does not specify particular security controls.

obligation_items.content: Be responsible for the Client Environment and its security.
obligation_items.object: Client’s on-premise or private cloud environment owned or controlled by Client
obligation_items.trigger: Client maintains or uses a Client Environment

clauses.scope_note: Section 3(b); Cohere Products and Client Outputs, including determining where human review is appropriate. Client Outputs exclude specified anonymous and aggregated Usage Data.
clauses.condition_explanation: Client is solely responsible for evaluating the Cohere Products and Client Outputs for accuracy and appropriateness for its use cases, including deciding where human review is appropriate. Cohere’s no-responsibility statement is not extracted as a client duty.

obligation_items.content: Evaluate Cohere Products and Client Outputs for accuracy and appropriateness for Client’s use cases, including determining where human review is appropriate.
obligation_items.trigger: Client’s evaluation or use of the Products and Outputs for its use cases

clauses.scope_note: Section 3(c); Client Credentials and access to Cohere Products.
clauses.condition_explanation: Credentials must be kept secure, provided to and used only by authorized Users, and not shared between more than one unique User. Client is also assigned responsibility for unauthorized access or use using those credentials; the clause does not specify a separate remedial action.

obligation_items.content: Keep Client Credentials secure, provide them only to authorized Users, ensure they are used only by authorized Users, and prevent sharing between more than one unique User.
obligation_items.trigger: Credentials are issued, held, or used to access Cohere Products

clauses.scope_note: Section 4(c); Client Inputs only. Client grants Cohere a nonexclusive, worldwide, royalty-free, irrevocable, sublicensable, transferable, fully paid-up right to access, collect, use, process, store, disclose, and transmit those inputs.
clauses.condition_explanation: The granted purposes are providing Cohere Products and exercising rights or performing obligations under the CLA, including ensuring Client’s compliance with the CLA and Usage Policy. This grant concerns Client Inputs, not Client Outputs.

clauses.scope_note: Section 5; usage information report for Client’s use of each Cohere Product instance. The report will not require Confidential Information contained in Client Data.
clauses.condition_explanation: Client must provide the report to Cohere, directly or through Partner as Cohere specifies, use Cohere’s Usage Report, and provide the information requested in it. The Confidential Information limitation bounds requested report content.

obligation_items.content: Provide Cohere’s Usage Report and all information requested in it, directly or through Partner as Cohere specifies; the report must not require Confidential Information contained in Client Data.
obligation_items.object: Usage information report for each Cohere Product instance
obligation_items.trigger: Client uses a Cohere Product instance and Cohere specifies the reporting route and requests report information

coverage_notes: Partner Terms, including any Order Form and Scope of Work, are not supplied; the license’s product scope, entitlements, and additional conditions therefore cannot be fully determined.
The Usage Policy and Documentation are incorporated by reference and may be updated; their substantive rules are not supplied.
Section 5 defines a reporting obligation and limits report content, but the supplied text does not provide the referenced Usage Report itself.
The grant in Section 4(c) concerns Client Inputs and does not itself establish ownership or a license concerning Client Outputs.

Models the listed and subsequently advised Restricted Locations.

Models credential security, authorized-user limitation, and the one-unique-user sharing restriction.
